test_cases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click login button
test_cases.expected_results: User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard
